from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

H,W=SRC.shape[:2]
S=4

def mask_polygon(points, blur=0):
    im=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.polygon([(round(x*S),round(y*S)) for x,y in points],fill=255)
    if blur: im=im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(blur*S))

tex=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(SRC[105:139,88:123]).convert('L'),dtype=float)

def arrpt(p):return np.array(p,dtype=float)

def overlay(canvas,layer):
    if layer.size!=(W,H):layer=layer.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    canvas.alpha_composite(layer)


def capsule(layer,p,q,r,color=(23,27,31), metal=False):
    """Analytically shaded rigid cylinder in orthographic camera coordinates."""
    p,q=arrpt(p[:2])*S,arrpt(q[:2])*S
    r=float(r)*S
    vec=q-p; length=np.linalg.norm(vec)
    if length<.1:return
    u=vec/length; n=np.array([-u[1],u[0]])
    x0=max(0,int(min(p[0],q[0])-r-2));x1=min(W*S,int(max(p[0],q[0])+r+3))
    y0=max(0,int(min(p[1],q[1])-r-2));y1=min(H*S,int(max(p[1],q[1])+r+3))
    if x1<=x0 or y1<=y0:return
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1];dx=xx+.5-p[0];dy=yy+.5-p[1]
    along=dx*u[0]+dy*u[1];side=dx*n[0]+dy*n[1]
    excess=along-np.clip(along,0,length)
    dist=np.sqrt(side**2+excess**2)
    alpha=np.clip(r+.5-dist,0,1)
    v=np.clip(side/r,-1,1); nz=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-v*v))
    diffuse=np.clip(-.39*v*n[0]-.52*v*n[1]+.68*nz,0,1)
    spec=np.exp(-((v+.42)/.13)**2)*(14 if not metal else 40)
    color=np.asarray(color,dtype=float)
    shade=.44+.84*diffuse
    vals=color[None,None,:]*shade[...,None]+spec[...,None]
    ti=(np.floor(np.clip(along,0,length)/S*.75).astype(int))%tex.shape[0]
    tj=(np.floor((side/r+1)*15).astype(int))%tex.shape[1]
    vals+=tex[ti,tj,None]*.55
    rim=np.clip((dist/r-.87)/.13,0,1)
    vals*=1-.38*rim[...,None]
    out=np.concatenate([np.clip(vals,0,255),alpha[...,None]*255],axis=2).astype('uint8')
    layer.alpha_composite(Image.fromarray(out,'RGBA'),(x0,y0))


def joint(layer,c,r):
    x,y=c[:2]; d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    def ell(a,b,rad,fill):d.ellipse(((a-rad)*S,(b-rad)*S,(a+rad)*S,(b+rad)*S),fill=fill)
    ell(x,y,r,(13,16,19,255));ell(x-.35,y-.5,r-.8,(44,48,52,255))
    ell(x+.55,y+.35,r-1.9,(25,28,31,255));ell(x+.1,y-.1,r-3,(18,22,26,255))
    for angle in [35,155,275]:
        a=math.radians(angle);xx=x+(r-2.0)*math.cos(a);yy=y+(r-2.0)*math.sin(a)
        ell(xx,yy,.52,(107,111,112,255));ell(xx+.13,yy+.16,.20,(22,25,28,255))


def ik(base,wrist,side):
    # Exact two-link inverse kinematics in 3D. Camera sees x,y; z is foreshortening.
    base=arrpt(base); wrist=np.r_[wrist,8.]
    diff=wrist-base;dist=np.linalg.norm(diff);u=diff/dist
    L1,L2=85.,75.
    a=(L1*L1-L2*L2+dist*dist)/(2*dist)
    h=math.sqrt(max(0,L1*L1-a*a))
    v=np.array([side*.065,0,1.]); v-=np.dot(v,u)*u;v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
    e=base+a*u+h*v
    return base,e,wrist


def arm(layer,contact,side,opening=2.6):
    # Parallel-jaw tools aim diagonally toward the plate. Links rotate as rigid solids.
    contact=arrpt(contact)
    direction=arrpt((-.68,-.733) if side==1 else (.64,-.768))
    normal=arrpt((-direction[1],direction[0]))
    palm=contact-direction*10.8
    wrist=palm-direction*7
    base=(220,176,0) if side==1 else (48,177,0)
    b,e,w=ik(base,wrist,side)
    capsule(layer,b,e,7.9,(26,29,32))
    joint(layer,e,8.1)
    capsule(layer,e,w,6.35,(21,25,29))
    # Inlaid mechanical spine, distinct fixed end collars, and a pivoting wrist.
    ep=e[:2];wp=w[:2]; ax=wp-ep;ln=np.linalg.norm(ax)
    if ln>4:
        ax/=ln;no=arrpt((-ax[1],ax[0]))
        capsule(layer,ep+no*3.2+ax*6,wp+no*3.2-ax*5,.68,(78,83,86),True)
        for frac in [.15,.84]:
            c=ep+(wp-ep)*frac
            capsule(layer,c-ax*1.45,c+ax*1.45,6.65,(35,39,42))
    joint(layer,w,6.5)
    capsule(layer,wrist,palm,5.4,(37,41,45))
    # Solid gripper housing with flat planar sides.
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    pts=[palm-direction*3-normal*5,palm+direction*3.4-normal*4.4,
         palm+direction*3.4+normal*4.4,palm-direction*3+normal*5]
    d.polygon([tuple(p*S) for p in pts],fill=(22,26,29,255))
    capsule(layer,palm-direction*2-normal*3.7,palm+direction*2-normal*3.5,.7,(105,111,114),True)
    return contact,direction,normal,palm,opening


def jaws(layer,tool):
    c,d,n,p,gap=tool
    # Moving opposed fingers: same length and thickness at every opening.
    for s in [-1,1]:
        a=p+d*2+n*s*(gap+1.3)
        b=c-d*1.0+n*s*gap
        capsule(layer,a,b,1.45,(39,44,48))
        capsule(layer,b,b+d*2.0-n*s*.6,1.15,(15,18,21))
        capsule(layer,a-n*s*.5,b-n*s*.5,.38,(124,128,127),True)


def interp(keys,t):
    if t<=keys[0][0]:return np.array(keys[0][1],float)
    for (ta,a),(tb,b) in zip(keys[:-1],keys[1:]):
        if t<=tb:
            u=(t-ta)/(tb-ta);u=u*u*(3-2*u)
            return np.array(a)*(1-u)+np.array(b)*u
    return np.array(keys[-1][1],float)

# Pose is center x,y, cosine of yaw, in-plane tilt (degrees).
poses=[(0,(159.3,47,.34,0)),(4,(159.3,47,.34,0)),
 (5,(158,39,.39,-2)),(6,(152,34,.47,-4)),(7,(143,33,.57,-6)),
 (8,(133,35,.65,-6)),(9,(127,37,.67,-5)),(10,(127,37,.67,-5)),
 (11,(119,40,.65,-4)),(12,(108,44,.60,-3)),(13,(95,49,.54,-2)),
 (14,(83,56,.48,-1)),(15,(73,64,.43,1)),(16,(66,72,.38,3)),
 (17,(64.5,76,.36,4)),(19,(64.5,76,.36,4))]


def sample_bilinear(a,x,y):
    x=np.clip(x,0,W-1.001);y=np.clip(y,0,H-1.001)
    xi=x.astype(int);yi=y.astype(int);fx=x-xi;fy=y-yi
    return a[yi,xi]*(1-fx[...,None])*(1-fy[...,None])+a[yi,xi+1]*fx[...,None]*(1-fy[...,None])+a[yi+1,xi]*(1-fx[...,None])*fy[...,None]+a[yi+1,xi+1]*fx[...,None]*fy[...,None]


def plate_layer(pose):
    cx,cy,cosyaw,tilt=pose;ang=math.radians(tilt);co,si=math.cos(ang),math.sin(ang)
    rx=22*cosyaw;ry=22.
    # Orthographic projection of a circular, rigid ceramic disk rotated in 3D.
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:H*S,0:W*S];xx=(xx+.5)/S;yy=(yy+.5)/S
    dx,dy=xx-cx,yy-cy
    u=(co*dx+si*dy)/rx;v=(-si*dx+co*dy)/ry
    rr=np.sqrt(u*u+v*v)
    aa=np.clip((1-rr)*S*min(rx,ry)+.5,0,1)
    sample=sample_bilinear(SRC.astype(float),159.25+u*7.25,47+v*21.3)
    # Revealing the face brightens its ivory glaze, while preserving source grain.
    reveal=np.clip((cosyaw-.34)/.34,0,1)
    bowl=np.exp(-((rr-.84)/.065)**2)
    rim=np.exp(-((rr-.956)/.043)**2)
    originalgrey=np.clip(sample.mean(-1),75,221)
    smoothbase=157+v*24-u*9
    lum=originalgrey*(1-.36*reveal)+smoothbase*.36*reveal
    lum+=reveal*22
    color=np.stack([lum+6,lum+3,lum-6],axis=-1)
    color-=bowl[...,None]*(7+5*reveal)
    color+=rim[...,None]*(17+13*reveal)
    color+=np.clip(-u,0,1)[...,None]*rim[...,None]*13
    # Thin physical ceramic thickness on the right-hand contour.
    color*=1-(np.clip(u,0,1)*np.clip((rr-.975)/.03,0,1)*.17)[...,None]
    rgba=np.concatenate([np.clip(color,0,255),aa[...,None]*255],axis=2).astype('uint8')
    return Image.fromarray(rgba,'RGBA')


def contact_for(pose,side):
    cx,cy,c,a=pose;ang=math.radians(a)
    ux=22*c*.88*side;vy=-3.8
    return np.array([cx+ux*math.cos(ang)-vy*math.sin(ang),cy+ux*math.sin(ang)+vy*math.cos(ang)])

for f in range(1,20):
    pose=interp(poses,f)
    rc=contact_for(pose,1);lc=contact_for(pose,-1)
    if f<4:
        rc=interp([(0,(197,84)),(2,(187,64)),(4,contact_for(interp(poses,4),1))],f)
    if f>=11:
        rc=interp([(10,contact_for(interp(poses,10),1)),(12,(164,58)),(15,(184,83)),(19,(197,98))],f)
    if f<9:
        lc=interp([(0,(67,105)),(3,(69,101)),(5,(84,77)),(7,(102,49)),(9,contact_for(interp(poses,9),-1))],f)
    if f>=18:
        lc=interp([(17,contact_for(interp(poses,17),-1)),(18,(51,80)),(19,(49,94))],f)
    ropen=4.0 if f<4 else (1.5 if f<10 else 4.1)
    lopen=4.2 if f<9 else (1.5 if f<18 else 4.4)
    bg=clean.copy()
    if f>=5:
        bg=bg*(1-plate_mask[...,None])+plate_clean*plate_mask[...,None]
    canvas=Image.fromarray(np.clip(bg,0,255).astype('uint8')).convert('RGBA')
    # Contact shadow on the destination tray grows only during the final descent.
    if f>=14:
        sh=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S));dd=ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
        amt=min(1,(f-13)/4)
        dd.ellipse((45*S,91*S,82*S,101*S),fill=(1,2,4,int(50*amt)))
        sh=sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(2.0*S));overlay(canvas,sh)
    limbs=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S))
    rt=arm(limbs,rc,1,ropen)
    lt=arm(limbs,lc,-1,lopen)
    overlay(canvas,limbs)
    if f>=5:overlay(canvas,plate_layer(pose))
    fg=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S))
    jaws(fg,rt);jaws(fg,lt)
    overlay(canvas,fg)
    # Metal tray's near wire occludes the low edge of the seated plate naturally.
    if f>=16:
        cover=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S));d=ImageDraw.Draw(cover)
        amount=min(1,(f-15)/2)
        # Restrict to existing wire geometry immediately in front of the disk.
        d.line([(52*S,98*S),(70*S,102*S)],fill=(27,30,31,int(240*amount)),width=int(1.6*S))
        d.line([(52*S,97.7*S),(70*S,101.7*S)],fill=(86,89,87,int(190*amount)),width=max(1,int(.45*S)))
        overlay(canvas,cover)
    out=np.asarray(canvas.convert('RGB')).copy()
    # The acquisition transition retains the original photographic texture at rest.
    if f==1:out=np.rint(SRC*.40+out*.60).astype('uint8')
    frames.append(out)
